evidence.claim: Coveme trasforma da 60 anni un materiale impiegato in energie rinnovabili, stampa, microelettronica e trasporti, con uno stabilimento in Italia e 9 linee produttive.
evidence.quote: We have a deep-rooted and unique knowledge thanks to 60 years of experience in transforming this extraordinary material. || In our manufacturing site in Italy we run 9 production lines that are equipped with the latest technologies, managed by highly qualified personnel and supported by two state-of-the-art R & D laboratories. || Our materials are employed in advanced and fast growing industries such as renewable energies, graphic and industrial print, microelectronics, transport and household appliances.
